name: How can I maximize space in a small bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: How can I maximize space in a small bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To maximize space in a small bathroom, consider installing a wall-mounted toilet or vanity to free up floor space. A corner shower can also be more efficient than a traditional rectangular one. Using light colors for walls and tiles, incorporating large mirrors, and utilizing recessed shelving or niche storage can also create the illusion of a larger, more open space. We can help design solutions tailored to your small bathroom.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maximize small bathroom space with wall-mounted fixtures, corner showers, light colors, large mirrors, and recessed storage.
